For example, customers can purchase a non-consumable product only once, so delete that transaction to retest the purchase. Delete subscription transactions to retest introductory offers. For more information, see [`Implementing introductory offers in your app`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/StoreKit/implementing-introductory-offers-in-your-app). If your app uses the [`Original API for in-app purchase`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/in-app_purchase/original_api_for_in-app_purchase), refresh the receipt to get an updated receipt without the deleted transaction.
